purpose: Teach Plex to bind exact evidence in a natural-language coding request to concrete coding intent before any file-conditioned editing work begins.

representation.reasonFileContextIsDeferred: Phase 2 is finishing request-to-coding-intent understanding. Supplied-file conditioning begins in Phase 3.

groundingRules.targetEvidence: targetEvidence must be an exact case-insensitive substring of the coding request and must name the thing the user asked to change.
groundingRules.bindings: Every binding.evidence value must be an exact case-insensitive substring of the request. The associated kind/key/value triple must express the concrete coding meaning of that evidence.
groundingRules.action: Action is learned directly from natural create/modify/remove wording. Remove examples carry no behavior bindings because removal is fully specified by action plus target evidence.
groundingRules.prohibited: Do not use targetRole, searchHints, milestone-prefixed labels, generic filler semantics, repository lookup concepts, or invented evidence that does not appear in the request.

splitPolicy.principle: Validation uses familiar targets, actions, and individual coding intents in novel request-to-intent combinations and different natural surface forms.

postTrainingDevelopmentGate.purpose: Regression/transfer comparison only. The P2-31 structured-plan representation is not the product target.

decisionBoundary: P2-47 authorizes deterministic candidate generation and review only. It does not authorize packing a training bundle, staging a checkpoint, creating an optimizer, running gradient updates, or starting P2-48.
